sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 35 Conduct of General Elections Ninth Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
CONDUCT OF GENERAL
ELECTIONS
(NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF
EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 35 OF 2002
An Order further to amend the
Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 6th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
6-11-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.-------(1) This Order may be called the Conduct of General
Elections (Ninth Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

CONDUCT OF GENERAL ELECTIONS
CONDUCT OF GENERAL
ELECTIONS
(NINTH AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 2002
CHIEF
EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 35 OF 2002
An Order further to amend the
Conduct of General Elections Order, 2002.
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 6th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
6-11-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of Article 8D,
Chief Executive's Order 7 of 2002.-- In the Conduct of General Elections
Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order 7 of 2002), in Article 8D, in clause (2)
in sub-clause (i), for the word "involving" the word "or"
shall be substituted and shall be deemed to have always been so substituted.
